import sys

def main():
    import sys
    import collections
    s = sys.stdin.read().strip()
    n = len(s)
    count = collections.Counter(s)
    max_count = max(count.values())
    unique_shifts = n - max_count
    probability = unique_shifts / n
    print(f"{probability:.15f}")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
